dc:title: Ambiquality IEQ observations (CSV)
dc:description: Tabular (CSVW) schema for the streamed observations CSV export (F17) and the monthly CSV archives. The columns carry the same SSN/SOSA + QUDT semantics published as JSON-LD, so a CSVW processor can lift the rows into the same RDF model.

columns.name: sensor_id
columns.dc:description: UUID of the sensor (device) that produced the reading.

columns.name: unit
columns.dc:description: Unit symbol as reported by the sensor.

columns.name: quantity_kind_uri
columns.dc:description: QUDT quantity-kind URI for the observed property (empty when the parameter has no QUDT mapping).

columns.name: unit_uri
columns.dc:description: QUDT unit URI (empty when the parameter has no QUDT mapping).

columns.name: observed_at
columns.dc:description: Sensor clock time the reading was taken (ISO 8601, UTC).

columns.name: received_at
columns.dc:description: Server acceptance time stamped at ingestion (ISO 8601, UTC).

columns.name: is_invalid
columns.dc:description: Soft-invalidation flag; measurement values are never deleted or mutated.
